context: A Kansai friend rants over the weather with his girlfriend
purpose: Teach: 木曜日/ネコ/彼等/他方/昨今/去る/こりゃ/あつ

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: あー、こりゃかなわんわ。昨今の夏、あつすぎひん？
lines.en: Ah, this is unbearable. The recent summers are too hot, aren't they?
lines.style: Frustrated Kansai male venting casually to girlfriend

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ほんまやね。木曜日の予報も三十五度やって。
lines.en: Really. Thursday's forecast is also thirty-five degrees.
lines.style: Soft sympathetic feminine tone agreeing gently with him

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 先月から雨ばっかで、今度は猛暑かいな。テレビの予報士、彼等ほんま当てになれへんわ。
lines.en: Since last month it was nothing but rain, and now this heat. Those TV forecasters really can't be trusted.
lines.style: Grumbling Kansai male complaining with exaggerated exasperation

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: でも農家さんは助かるけど、他方で街の人はしんどいしね。難しいよね。
lines.en: But farmers are relieved, while on the other hand city folks suffer. It's complicated.
lines.style: Thoughtful gentle girlfriend offering a balanced perspective softly

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: うちのネコもベランダで伸びとるわ。クーラー無しやと干物になるで。
lines.en: Even our cat is sprawled out on the balcony. Without AC he'd turn into dried fish.
lines.style: Affectionate joking Kansai humor about household pet

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ふふ、可哀想に。去る七月の暑さもひどかったし、今夜は冷たいおそうめん作ってあげよっか？
lines.en: Haha, poor thing. Last July's heat was awful too. Shall I make cold somen noodles tonight?
lines.style: Sweet caring girlfriend recalling past heat with affection

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: おお、頼むわ。ほんま、お前おってくれてよかったわ。
lines.en: Oh, please do. Honestly, I'm so glad I have you.
lines.style: Softened Kansai male showing rare tender gratitude warmly
